benchmark.name: 99-point multidisciplinary design rigor bar
benchmark.no_affiliation: This internal benchmark does not claim endorsement, review, or affiliation by Jen Darhy Bucci, Anduril, or Active Theory.

dimensions.name: Distinctive identity and memorability
dimensions.proof: A sharp outsider can identify Manzanita from an unlabeled crop, motion fragment, control, data plate, or printout without confusing it with another AXM surface or a generic dashboard.

dimensions.name: Human and mission clarity
dimensions.proof: Every state makes the actor, purpose, source, authority, next safe action, and prohibited consequence legible without requiring a manual.

dimensions.name: Cross-disciplinary system coherence
dimensions.proof: Brand, product, imagery, mapping, illustration, motion, copy, data, export, and handoff use one recognizable grammar without becoming repetitive.

dimensions.name: Typography and optical finish
dimensions.proof: Display, editorial, label, data, and compact-width type all pass optical fit, pair spacing, break, rhythm, contrast, zoom, and fallback tests.

dimensions.name: Visual and material language
dimensions.proof: Images, maps, plates, diagrams, textures, lines, icons, and states have intentional hierarchy, source class, and production quality at every scale.

dimensions.name: Interaction semantics
dimensions.proof: Every control changes the underlying operating aperture or state and never substitutes a label change for a functional change.

dimensions.name: Motion and temporal continuity
dimensions.proof: Motion explains scale, source change, registration, state transition, or handoff; reduced motion preserves all meaning.

dimensions.name: Live data, source custody, and degradation
dimensions.proof: Every live or derived claim exposes source, time, transform, uncertainty, rights, cache rule, health, and failure state.

dimensions.name: Responsive and accessible operation
dimensions.proof: Desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile, compact, keyboard, touch, screen reader, 200 percent zoom, and reduced motion preserve the same hierarchy and actions.

dimensions.name: Performance and resilience
dimensions.proof: The product meets defined budgets on realistic devices and remains useful under slow, intermittent, offline, stale, and provider-outage conditions.

dimensions.name: Fit, finish, and perceptual QA
dimensions.proof: No visible clipping, loose spacing, weak crop, underdrawn state, generic placeholder, accidental default, or unresolved edge survives release review.

dimensions.name: Continuity, privacy, and release governance
dimensions.proof: Public and private projections, rights, purpose limits, exports, rollback, receipts, and cold-successor replay are complete and independently verifiable.
